Recorded claim:
A historical review of D329733 at HEAD bdbbffbd92974021098d6e1639af2394ce2121b1 reported that clearing an editable Date value still let an IsAfter filter save with date 0. The reported match code then matched messages after 1970-01-01. Check blank Date values before saving this filter type. This is a prior review finding, not confirmation that the current revision still has the defect.

Provenance: 59edb68b12114cdd49c4c949a07c3b23029038ff0d3565ca16e5e927038ec5e2. Original evidence IDs: 8fee30dcf7d0d514430788e4ec42fc1bc54db5125fd24653348a3f7c235823b9.
This is a recorded historical interpretation, not independent source verification. Source quotes from personal imports or unconfirmed-access records remain private. Historical test results are reported outcomes; no tests were rerun for this backfill.
